title: Arrange and Group: z-order + Ctrl+G
description: Z-order and grouping absent. (1) Modify > Arrange > Bring to Front (Ctrl+Shift+Up), Send to Back (Ctrl+Shift+Down), Bring Forward (Ctrl+Up), Send Backward (Ctrl+Down) — reorder displayObjects array within the keyframe. (2) Ctrl+G groups selected objects: create a new MovieClip symbol containing the selected objects, replace them with a SymbolInstance at their collective bounds center. (3) Ctrl+Shift+G / Modify > Ungroup: if the selected instance refers to a symbol with a single layer+keyframe, explode its display objects back into the scene timeline at the transformed positions. Wire to MenuBar Modify menu and keyboard shortcuts in StageArea. See docs/04, docs/07.
